verdict.rationale: Evidence shows a managed remote/enterprise offering (db:// remote tables, API-key/OAuth auth, S3-compatible storage) implying a cloud service, but there is no explicit documentation of programmatic provisioning (e.g., API/CLI/Terraform to spin up or manage database instances) and the OpenAPI probe returned 404s. Missing for 10: explicit provisioning API/CLI docs, infrastructure-as-code examples, independent confirmation of self-service cloud instance creation.
